notes.title: Polishing the Game!
notes.content:
Hi! Here's a small update, although it's a pretty large update by comparison to the 2 others that this game has had.[b] I've added...[/b]
[list]
[*]
A new and improved main menu
[*]
Less blur in world 5
[*]
Visual changes in world 5
[/list]
[b]Boring stuff:[/b]
[list]
[*]
Delta-time movement
[*]
Throne room entrance bugfix
[*]
Changes to elevator light "cutscene"
[*]
Going back down floors in World 5
[*]
Fixed not being able to teleport to World 2 with full bead necklace
[/list]
That's it! I told you it was small. 
Thank you for the support on this game, even though it's very small. It means a lot!
